CPV.note: A university research project in early testing, not an AI tool inside a public sector system.

facts.fact: The Universidade de Cabo Verde says its Interreg MAC-funded AP-BYTE_2CAP project with the University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, in early testing, uses AI to process drone hyperspectral data for agriculture on Santiago and Sao Vicente, with a planned two-year term.
